Choices to settle

Card floats over a live view of the city (here a gradient). Count shows as "3 cities" so the user sees the world is plural before they see Create New. The two sample cities besides Winchester are placeholders.

mock Two options: Sandbox and Assimilate. Try three treatments and tell us which one you understand without help (counts are kept on this device only).

Sandbox mock

OmniTile: place any tile on a small hex footprint. A new topology you can reroll and parameterize, played as a game. The footprint here is five hexes across the middle row, in rows of 3, 4, 5, 4, 3, which is 19 tiles (Evan said about fifteen; five-wide on a hex layout is nineteen, so we use 19).

Assimilate mock of the flow

Photo or words in, one themed tile out, kept as a personal experiment until approved for the shared world. The camera icon tells it apart from Sandbox.

Before you send anything
You're responsible for what you upload and must have the right to share it. Sexual or nude material and anything not family-friendly is turned away. Photos with children in them are held back for now. A photo is looked at once to check it and make your scene, and isn't kept. (Wording needs review by someone qualified; it does not remove all legal risk.)
